text:
Samira Khan: Heads up — Horizon Analytics (acct: horizon-analytics) requested a temporary EU config change for onboarding/demo tomorrow 09:00 CET. CS-4823.
They need: temporary rate increase for EU (50 rps sustained, 200 rps burst for 2h during demo), IP allowlist for three entries, and provisioning on an EU edge node. Can we get this staged and monitored? @Marta Ruiz @Liam O'Connor

Marta Ruiz: Noted. I'll flag renewal touchpoint — they're in active talks for Dedicated in Q3 so this is high priority. Any SLA impact we should record? Also please schedule a 30m enablement call with the customer.

Priya Narayanan: Confirming from Horizon: demo is Tuesday 09:00 CET. IPs to whitelist: 198.51.100.12, 198.51.100.13, 203.0.113.0/29. They want 50 rps baseline, with 200 rps spike for 2h around the demo. TTL for the temp rules is OK to be 72h.

Liam O'Connor: Acknowledged. I'll add the allowlist and apply a temporary rate-policy via infra. Plan: create tenant policy, attach to horizon-analytics in eu-west-1 edge pool, and open INF ticket for edge capacity (INF-927). Running this unless objections. Example command I'll use:

```bash
# add allowlist
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tenants/horizon-analytics/allowlist \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"ips": ["198.51.100.12","198.51.100.13","203.0.113.0/29"]}'

# apply temporary rate policy
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tenants/horizon-analytics/policies \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"policy_name":"temp-demo-eu","region":"eu-west-1","baseline_rps":50,"burst_rps":200,"burst_window_mins":120,"ttl_hours":72}'
```

Noah Patel: Oncall here — I'll monitor request/latency errors and add a temporary alert suppression so we don't get noisy paging during the demo. Also check that KV cache warmup won't throttle them unexpectedly.

deploy-bot: change submitted: change-4823 by Liam O'Connor — pending approval.

Samira Khan: Thanks team. Marta I'll book the enablement slot and add the playbook notes to CS-4823. Priya I'll confirm when config live.

Liam O'Connor: Done — allowlist entries and rate policy applied. Changes pushed to eu-west-1 edge pool 'eu-cdg-1'. Patch ID: patch-20260304-4823. INF-927 opened for edge capacity; ETA ~30m for final verification.

Priya Narayanan: I can see requests succeeding from our side, demo traffic looks normal. Thanks!

Marta Ruiz: Marking onboarding step complete and logging renewal touchpoint in CRM. :tada:

Noah Patel: Monitoring healthy, no error spikes. I'll remove suppression and close monitoring notes after 72h unless we see problems.

Samira Khan: Closing thread for now — CS-4823 will have the notes and follow-ups. Great job. :thumbsup:
